generate_dummy_code_pybind11: generate dummy C++ pybind11 binding code for a given number of classes with random functions
generate_dummy_code_boost: generate dummy C++ boost python binding code for a given number of classes with random functions
run_benchmark_pybind11: run the pybind11 compilation benchmark by calling generate_dummy_code_pybind11 with increasing class counts
run_benchmark_boost: run the boost python compilation benchmark by calling generate_dummy_code_boost with increasing class counts
review_benchmark_functions: review the generate_dummy_code_pybind11 and generate_dummy_code_boost functions to understand benchmark code generation
